<!--
INSTRUCTOR-ONLY. Renders to progress.html, which is GIT-IGNORED — it lists students.
Data-driven; replaces last term's hand-typed tracker.

Inputs:
  - course.yml               (thresholds, session/homework counts — the single source)
  - tracking/students.csv    (roster; keep the real one as students.local.csv, git-ignored)
  - tracking/attendance.csv  (the only manual datum; long format: github_username, week, present)
  - tracking/hw_status.csv   (AUTO-derived from the org by automation/tracking.ps1)
Render:  quarto render tracking/progress.qmd
-->

```{r config}
library(tidyverse)
library(yaml)

find_root <- function(start = ".") {
  d <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "course.yml"))) {
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (parent == d) stop("course.yml not found above ", start)
    d <- parent
  }
  d
}
root <- find_root()
cfg  <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(root, "course.yml"))

# --- thresholds come from course.yml, never from this file ---
N_SESSIONS     <- cfg$sessions$count
N_HOMEWORKS    <- cfg$homework$count
MIN_ATTENDANCE <- ceiling(cfg$thresholds$attendance * N_SESSIONS)
MIN_HOMEWORK   <- ceiling(cfg$thresholds$homework  * N_HOMEWORKS)

read_local <- function(base) {
  # prefer the git-ignored *.local.csv (real data) if present, else the committed template
  local <- file.path(root, "tracking", paste0(base, ".local.csv"))
  path  <- if (file.exists(local)) local else file.path(root, "tracking", paste0(base, ".csv"))
  readr::read_csv(path, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)
}
lc <- function(x) tolower(trimws(x))   # GitHub usernames are case-insensitive
```

```{r load}
students   <- read_local("students")   |> mutate(github_username = lc(github_username))
attendance <- read_local("attendance") |> mutate(github_username = lc(github_username))

# Homework status produced by: ./automation/tracking.ps1  (writes tracking/hw_status.csv)
hw_path <- file.path(root, "tracking", "hw_status.csv")
hw <- if (file.exists(hw_path)) {
  readr::read_csv(hw_path, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(github_username = lc(github_username))
} else {
  tibble(github_username = character(), week = integer(), submitted = integer())
}
```

```{r summarise}
att_by_student <- attendance |>
  filter(present == 1) |>
  distinct(github_username, week) |>
  count(github_username, name = "attended")

hw_by_student <- hw |>
  filter(submitted == 1) |>
  distinct(github_username, week) |>
  count(github_username, name = "homeworks")

progress <- students |>
  select(github_username, section) |>
  left_join(att_by_student, by = "github_username") |>
  left_join(hw_by_student,  by = "github_username") |>
  mutate(
    attended  = coalesce(attended, 0L),
    homeworks = coalesce(homeworks, 0L),
    pass_att  = attended  >= MIN_ATTENDANCE,
    pass_hw   = homeworks >= MIN_HOMEWORK,
    on_track  = pass_att & pass_hw
  )
```

```{r table}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(progress) == 0) {
  cat("_No students on the roster yet — fill `tracking/students.local.csv`._")
} else {
  progress |>
    arrange(desc(on_track), github_username) |>
    knitr::kable(
      col.names = c("GitHub", "Section", "Attended", "Homeworks", "Att ok", "HW ok", "On track"),
      caption = sprintf("Thresholds: attendance >= %d/%d, homework >= %d/%d.",
                        MIN_ATTENDANCE, N_SESSIONS, MIN_HOMEWORK, N_HOMEWORKS)
    )
}
```

```{r unmatched}
#| results: asis
# Submission repos whose username is not on the roster — usually a typo'd repo name.
unmatched <- setdiff(unique(hw$github_username), students$github_username)
if (length(unmatched)) {
  cat("\n**Submission repos not on the roster** (check the repo name or add to the roster): ",
      paste0("`", unmatched, "`", collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

Homework completion is derived automatically from submission repos on the org — nothing is
typed by hand except attendance.
